snowball refers to a self-reinforcing cascade in which initial sell-offs or liquidations trigger further sell-offs. snowball is used in DeFi forums and social media to warn of losses that can accelerate on their own.

WAGMI is an abbreviation for 'we are all gonna make it' and expresses collective optimism about the community's prospects. NGMI is an abbreviation for 'not gonna make it' and expresses pessimism that a person or project will fail. WAGMI / NGMI is used as a pair of opposing sentiment signals in DeFi forums and social media.

HODL denotes a strategy of holding crypto assets for the long term instead of selling during price drops. HODL originated from a misspelling of 'hold' in a 2013 Bitcoin forum post. HODL is used in DeFi communities to express conviction against short-term volatility.

FUD stands for fear, uncertainty and doubt. FUD refers to negative information or rumours spread to influence market sentiment. FUD is used in DeFi forums and social media to accuse others of spreading unwarranted warnings about risks.

REKT is slang meaning wrecked or financially destroyed. REKT describes a severe loss of funds, often caused by liquidation or an exploit. REKT is used in DeFi forums and social media to describe harms suffered by users.
